reader_summary.overview: This is Jesse Pujji and today we are breaking down CrowdStrike, the cybersecurity provider. Founded in 2011 by George Kurtz, the former CTO of McAfee. Today, CrowdStrike serves over 18,000 customers globally and is valued at $45 billion.

key_points.text: Founded in 2011 by George Kurtz, the former CTO of McAfee.
To break down CrowdStrike, I’m joined by Roneal Desai, a senior public market investor focused on enterprise software.
In our conversation, we discuss how CrowdStrike reinvented cybersecurity for the cloud era.
